clauses: I accept one (1) grey button, and I accept that my hand is already on it.
I will not form an attachment to the button. I have already formed an attachment to the button.
I accept that the button goes where it wants now, and my eyes go with it.
I will not chase it with the cursor. I understand that I will chase it with the cursor.
I accept a number under the counter showing how much {cur} I say per second.
The number is small. I will watch it anyway. Watching a number is easier than having a thought.
